figures.caption: Table 2: CSD indicators on CGA-Wiki (N=652; AMD on the 500 conversations with valid anchors). Kendall τ of rolling variance in the 5 turns preceding breakdown (derailing) or conversation end (civil); d: Cohen’s d between the two τ distributions. Under Benjamini-Hochberg correction, AMD Var (qBH=0.004), Lex. Div. VAR (qBH=0.004), Lex. Div. AC1 (qBH=0.004), and q̂DA VAR (qBH=0.043) remain significant at α=0.05.

Figure 1: Overview of the AMD framework: divergent anchor-conditioned affect distributions define AMD via TV distance (A-B); rising rolling-window variance before breakdown constitutes the CSD early-warning signal (C); the saddle-node bifurcation predicts abrupt, hysteretic collapse of repair coordination (D).
